layers.title: Murder rate by police precinct
layers.units: reported cases per 100,000 residents per year
layers.legend: Murders per 100,000 residents, Apr 2025 - Mar 2026. Metro average 73.

hatch_where.meaning: rate unreliable: small or commuter population (see rate_flag)

layers.source: Counts: SAPS quarterly crime statistics 2025/26, four quarters summed (1 Apr 2025 - 31 Mar 2026), saps.gov.za. Population: GeoTerraImage 2024 EA estimates summed by precinct, published by Western Cape Government PDO (licence: view only, flagged). Open alternative: GHS-POP R2023A 2025, 100 m, JRC, CC BY 4.0 (fields *_ghsl). Precincts: Western Cape Government Spatial Data Warehouse (2020); Makhaza rebuilt from the PDO 2024 EA assignment.
